title: Here’s Why Don’t Trespass in Your Underwear
description:
On January 27th, 2022, officers were dispatched to conduct a welfare check. The caller reported that her daughter was talking nonsense, acting very strangely, and wandering around in her underwear. Noticing her behavior, the officer tried to determine if the woman was under the influence of some kind of intoxicant. Here is what her mother told the police about her disorder. She continued to abuse the officers. The female was charged with Fleeing, non-moving traffic violence and resisting arrest.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
